post.summary: Creates an account and opens its first customer session.
Opens a customer session.
Opens an admin session; requires the auth:admin:sign-in permission.
Exchanges a refresh token for a new pair. Each refresh token works once.
Ends the session of the refresh token.

get.summary: Returns the caller's account, roles and permissions.

post.summary: Changes the caller's password, ends all their sessions and opens a new one.
Sends a link to the new address; the account moves there when the link is followed. Once a minute at most.

get.summary: The account's open sessions, one per sign-in, the most recently active first; the caller's own is marked.

delete.summary: Ends every session of the account but the caller's own; returns the ones that ended.
Ends one of the account's sessions; it cannot be renewed any more.

post.summary: Deletes the caller's account after checking the password; its sessions end and the other services delete their data. Cannot be undone.

get.summary: Lists accounts, newest first; optionally only those whose e-mail address contains the search text.
Returns an account with its roles and lock state.

delete.summary: Deletes the account and, through events, its data in every service. Not your own account, nor the last administrator; requires holding every permission of its roles. Cannot be undone.

post.summary: Stops the account from signing in and ends its sessions. Not allowed on your own account.
Lets the account sign in again and lifts a lockout after failed sign-ins.

put.summary: Gives the account a role. Requires holding every permission of the role.

delete.summary: Takes a role away from the account. Requires holding every permission of the role; not allowed on your own account.

get.summary: Lists every role with its permissions and how many users hold it.

post.summary: Creates a role.

put.summary: Replaces the role's name and permissions. The administrator role cannot be changed.

delete.summary: Deletes the role and takes it away from its holders. The administrator role cannot be deleted.

get.summary: Lists every permission a role can hold.

post.summary: Adds a profile to the caller's account.

put.summary: Renames a profile or changes its age rating.

delete.summary: Removes a profile; the last one cannot be removed.

put.summary: Puts a PIN on a profile, replaces it or takes it off; asks for the password again.

post.summary: Opens a locked profile for this sign-in; the next access token names it in profile_unlocked.

get.summary: Tells whether the caller's e-mail address is verified.

post.summary: Sends the caller a new verification link; earlier links stop working. Once a minute at most.
Verifies the e-mail address with the token from the link. Needs no sign-in; each token works once.
E-mails a password reset link if the address has an account. Answers the same whether it has one or not.
Sets a new password with the token from the link and ends every session of the account. Each token works once.
Moves the account to the address the link was sent to. Needs no sign-in; each token works once.
Adds the passkey the browser created for the options; the user is told by e-mail.
Checks the password again and returns the options for creating a passkey; they work once, for five minutes.

put.summary: Renames one of the account's passkeys.

delete.summary: Removes one of the account's passkeys; the user is told by e-mail.

post.summary: Options for signing in with a passkey; they work once, for five minutes.
Opens a customer session with the passkey that signed the options.
Opens an admin session with the passkey; requires the auth:admin:sign-in permission.
